Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
2. No one appears neither on behalf of appellant nor on behalf of accused-respondent even when the matter has been taken up in the revised list.
Sri Ajay Singh, learned A.G.A-I for the State is present.

3. The present appeal has been preferred by the appellant against the judgment and order dated 13.7.1978 acquitting the accused-respondent passed by Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra in Criminal Case No.327 of 1977, under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
4. Leave to appeal was granted vide order dated 19.7.1995 passed by coordinate Bench of this Court.

As per the office report dated 24.4.2024, the report of C.J.M., Agra dated 23.11.2021 has been N.S.A. vs Chandan Singh on 27 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147704461/
1 received stating therein that the sole accused-respondent Chandan Singh has died.
The said report has been sent after due verification.
5. This Court has perused the said report which states that the accused-respondent Chandan Singh has died.
6. In view of the above, the present appeal stands abated.
